$comment: First-party 5e ruleset on SRD 5.1. Every id here is this file's own choice: the Engine never looks for 'level', 'dex' or 'slots'. A $comment key is allowed on any object and ignored.

coverage.summary: Ability checks, skill checks, saving throws, the full character sheet, spell slots, hit dice, class resources, conditions and rests. Battles use Marinara's default combat, not 5e combat.

naturals.$comment: 2014 rules: a natural 20 or 1 decides attack rolls only. Checks and saves are pure arithmetic, unlike Marinara's own rules.

lists.$comment: Ki, Rage, Sorcery Points, Channel Divinity, Bardic Inspiration and the like, without shipping class tables. Each row is a live pool.
lists.label: Class resources

live.$comment: Fast-changing state. Starts from the build when a game copies the sheet, and lives with the game-state snapshot so a swipe rewinds it.

rests.$comment: Spending hit dice is a player choice made on the sheet; the rest itself does not spend them.
rests.label: Short rest

gm.checkGuidance: This game uses 5e rules from SRD 5.1. Call for an ability check, skill check or saving throw only when the outcome is uncertain and failure is interesting. Name the skill or the save and set a DC from the ladder below. Never add modifiers, never state a total and never decide the result: the Engine applies the character sheet and reports the outcome. A natural 20 or natural 1 has no special effect on checks or saves.
gm.sheetGuidance: The character sheets below are authoritative. A character can only cast a spell that is on their sheet and only with a slot they still have. When a character spends or regains a resource, takes damage, heals, gains or loses a condition, or rests, record it with the sheet command. If a command is refused, the fiction did not happen: narrate around it.

catalogs.$comment: Ready-made SRD 5.1 spells. A picked row is a copy the player can edit. Generated by scripts/build-5e-srd-catalogs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. Source: Open5e srd-2014 data, https://github.com/open5e/open5e-api, data/v2/wizards-of-the-coast/srd-2014, commit 0e594c370b4daa9c8d8690979a58eab615afd6d5, licensed CC-BY-4.0 like SRD 5.1 itself.
catalogs.label: Spells

catalogs.$comment: Class and subclass features. One pick fills the feature row and, where the SRD states a plain count, the class resource that tracks it. Generated by scripts/build-5e-srd-catalogs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. catalogs.label: Class features
